thread:
maria: Hey team — vuln triage requires temporary access to KMS-encrypted raw logs. Proposal: 2h timeboxed access, use KMS Grant to forensic proxy, strict no-persist policy. Thoughts?
samir: Grants are better than editing CMK policy for short ops. Add EncryptionContext subset to the grant so decrypts are tied to ticket.
frank-secops: Two risks: accidental retention and gaps in audit for encryption-context. Force scrub pipeline and log encryption-context via the proxy before decrypt.
claire: Suggested flow: snapshot -> s3://forensic-ephemeral/<ticket>/raw.enc -> create KMS Grant to role/log-proxy with EncryptionContext {"ticket":"SEC-2024-78"} -> analyst uses ephemeral bastion -> decrypt only on ephemeral disk -> scrub -> push redacted to s3://siem-ingest/redacted/<ticket>/ -> signed URL for sharing.
maria: Example grant CLI anyone?
samir: "aws kms create-grant --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111122223333:key/abcd-1234 --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/log-proxy --operations Decrypt --constraints EncryptionContextSubset={\"ticket\":\"SEC-2024-78\"}"
frank-secops: Also set object tag retention=incident-ephemeral and lifecycle expiry 7d as a safety net. Deny s3:PutObjectRetention and s3:PutObjectTagging from the ephemeral role.
claire: Enforce ephemeral workstation via SSM Session Manager, block uploads to external S3, EBS no-snapshot.
maria: Compliance wants proof-of-use. Proxy should log encryption-context + principal to security-audit index before decrypt. Also ensure CloudTrail records kms:Decrypt to audit bucket.
samir: After revoke, run a verification job: query CloudTrail + S3 access logs for GETs outside allowed IPs; alert if any.
audit-bot: Incident SEC-2024-78 created. Resources: s3://forensic-ephemeral/SEC-2024-78/, role forensic-jump-SEC-2024-78 (expires 2h).
maria: I'll update runbook with grant CLI + verification steps and open a PR. Thanks :thumbsup:
